lines.t: Verse 1
I thought I was being careful
Thought I knew what love should say
But somewhere in my heart
I let pride get in the way
Now I see it a little better
Though it hurts to see my sin
You have a way of showing me
What I keep hidden within
Chorus
Call me what I am
I won’t argue with it now
If it’s pride, then it’s pride
If I’m wrong, I’ll bow
I’ve been talking like I’m right
While I’m walking the other way
So call me what I am
I don’t wanna hide my face
Verse 2
I get tired of the tension
Of being shown I missed it
There’s a part of me that fights it
Even when I know I did it
I don’t like the way it feels, when the truth says what I won’t
But maybe that’s the only way
This heart of mine will learn
Chorus
Call me what I am
I won’t argue with it now
If it’s pride, then it’s pride
If I’m wrong, I’ll bow
I’ve been talking like I’m right
While I’m walking the other way
So call me what I am
I don’t wanna hide my face
Bridge
I lay down all my defenses
Here’s my heart, Lord, take it
Speak the truth, no more resistance
I lay down all my defenses
Here’s my heart, Lord, take it
Speak the truth, no more resistance
Outro
Say it plain, don’t dress it up
I’ve been wrong enough
Let it sit, let it stay
Till it changes me
